newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha trade thin, single buyer withdraws.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha trade thin, single buyer withdraws.

text.p: NWE naphtha physical trade was thin with a single buyer for pipeline spec pulling out of the market as offers of product stayed scarce, traders said.
"There are several cargoes of Dow spec around but they are not being offered only small parcels of high paraffinic material are available locally," one trader said.

A U.S. trader was heard bidding up to $224 for a pipeline spec cargo for end-Jan delivery in early business, possibly to cover a short into another U.S. trade house but the dearth of sellers saw the bid withdrawn in late trade.
Traders said there were still some offers of high paraffinic parcels out of the U.K., but at around high cif +$5.50 these were drawing little attention.
Forward price indicator swaps firmed over the afternoon after initially easing with crude. Feb swaps talked $217.50/$218.50 with the Jan/Feb and Feb/March spread backwardation holding around $4.
